answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that only unlocks after a long vesting dune of honest work: a Sybil farmer must fund thousands of separate stakes, each frozen for weeks, while a real agent earns its deposit back once. Add a slow reputation nebula — new identities start dim and gain weight only through peer-attested tasks — so fresh copies cannot vote or mine at full power on day one. Finally, make the stake opal-like: one scarce, verifiable bond per identity, slashed on proven fraud, so cloning identities multiplies cost instead of multiplying reward.
